title: What Your Tteokbokki Spice Level Says About Your Impatience
blurb: Spicy Korean rice cakes, graded by how fast you give up waiting.

questions.q: Time to pick a spice level. Tteokbokki is chewy rice cakes in gochujang, a sweet-hot pepper paste.
questions.a: Level 1. My tongue has a calendar.
questions.b: The hottest. Reading the rest of the menu is already too much waiting.

questions.q: Toppings. Melted cheese, fish cake (eomuk), or ramyeon sari, a nest of instant noodles.
questions.a: I name each one and plan the melt order.
questions.b: All of them. The chopsticks can figure it out.

questions.q: The pot lands. It is still very loudly steaming.
questions.a: I fan it with chopsticks like a person with a future.
questions.b: One blow, then it goes in. My tongue clocks in early.

questions.q: Move it to a plate, or eat straight from the pot?
questions.a: A plate. I am here for the cheese pull.
questions.b: Head in the pot. Plates are for people with time.

questions.q: There is sauce left. Bokkeumbap time: fried rice, finished in that same pan.
questions.a: Rice in, medium heat, every grain gets a coat.
questions.b: The rice hits the pan and the spoon is already moving.

results.title: Steam Saint
results.summary: Spice, toppings, rice, all in order. You let the steam finish talking. Your friends are done. You are still on bite one.
results.comment: The pot respects this pace. Nobody else does.

results.title: One Wild Bite
results.summary: You wait for almost everything. Then one scene, the chopsticks file a complaint, and the complaint wins.
results.comment: That single bite is the whole diagnosis.

results.title: Medium Heat
results.summary: You do let it cool. A little. The cheese has not even stretched and your mouth has already RSVP'd.
results.comment: Your patience lasts about as long as a fish cake keeps its shape.

results.title: Pot First
results.summary: Picking from the menu took longer than eating. Your tongue would like to schedule a meeting tomorrow.
results.comment: Bokkeumbap was not a plan. It was a reflex that came with rice.

results.title: Full Send
results.summary: Hottest level, every topping, the pot, the fried rice. You skipped the waiting in all five scenes.
results.comment: 'Let it cool' is a language you do not speak.
